Using the yeast gene deletion collection to customize gene expression. Substitute Teacher Despite the relative ease of genome manipulation in S. cerevisiae, researchers are always looking to learn still more convenient and rapid methods for substituting yeast promoters. Replacing a gene's native promoter with a heterolo-gous promoter of choice allows regulated expression and simplifies the task of discerning functional relevance. Although a host of clever chromosomal insertion strategies have been described over the years, the advent of the S. cerevisiae Genome Deletion Project provides an incredible resource for a further streamlined workflow.
